svg.title: System architecture: callers and clients, edge, services, AI layer, data
svg.desc: A request's route through a production AI system: phone, web and Slack clients; Cloudflare Workers edge with BFF auth; NestJS and FastAPI services with job queues, retries and n8n; an LLM router that sends small models first and Claude for hard calls, with RAG and evals in CI; multi-tenant Postgres with row-level security, field-level encryption, object storage and Prometheus.
